info.p: This test checks a block nested in an inline, in a paragraph that breaks onto a page with a different IPD. Line breaking runs a second time over the paragraph's stored sequences, and the nested block's positions were wrapped again; adding its areas re-entered the paragraph's block and FOP threw a NullPointerException (see also FOP-1912).
